fields.default: Why our classes never have more than eight people

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.default:
I started this school in 2014 in a room above a launderette, with six students and a kettle. Before that I spent ten years teaching in big academies, where a class of twenty meant each person spoke Spanish for about ninety seconds an hour.

Eight is the number

With eight people, everyone speaks every few minutes and nobody can hide at the back. With fewer than five, the conversation runs dry. So eight is where we stop, even when the waiting list is long.

What that means for you

  • Evening courses fill early. Book by the end of August for the autumn term.
  • If a group drops below five, we merge it or refund you in full.
  • Your teacher will know your name, your job and which tense you avoid.

Come and sit in on a class before you pay for anything. The kettle is still here.
